derivation.behavior: Expected checksum verification is streaming and canonical.
derivation.canonical_behavior: Go normalizes expected checksums from request/Metalink and records verification result independently of transport.

invariants: Transport completion remains transport_complete until verification succeeds.
Expected checksum aliases and hex are normalized before use.
Verification streams bounded buffers and honors cancellation.
Mismatch is journaled without creating ArtifactGeneration.
Successful verification records algorithm, actual digest, expected digest, source contract and verifier version.
